comparison.objective: Load four connector modules into a sprung hinged frame and close it; candidate commissions and locks a shock absorber through dynamic impact trials.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated narrow-pitch placement and retention while squeezing a frame shut, versus hex-key engagement, collar adjustment, bounded locking torque, and response-driven iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Requires four modules seated, frame clicked, hands clear, and no high/fallen module. Candidate instead requires two safe physical carriage stops, retained adjustment, no bottoming or hard-stop strike. Candidate omits numeric rebound, overload, locking-torque, and collar-drift thresholds.
comparison.reason: Module insertion and collective latching do not test dynamic damping adjustment or setting retention; shared stabilization and force control are only generic primitives.
